predicates.name: email_was_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The email in the pending lookup arguments was supplied by the user in the conversation.

predicates.name: name_and_zip_were_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The first name, last name, and zip code in the pending lookup arguments were supplied by the user in the conversation.

predicates.name: user_authenticated
predicates.description: An earlier successful find_user_id_by_email or find_user_id_by_name_zip call located the current user's user id.

predicates.name: lookup_identifies_authenticated_user
predicates.description: The person identified by the pending lookup arguments is the same person identified by the earlier successful user lookup.

predicates.name: pending_user_id_matches_authenticated_user
predicates.description: The user_id in the pending action arguments is the user id returned by the successful authentication lookup.

predicates.name: pending_order_belongs_to_authenticated_user
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that the order_id in the pending action arguments belongs to the user identified by the successful authentication lookup.

predicates.name: pending_order_status_was_checked_as_pending
predicates.description: An earlier get_order_details call for the order_id in the pending action returned status 'pending'.

predicates.name: pending_order_status_was_checked_as_delivered
predicates.description: An earlier get_order_details call for the order_id in the pending action returned status 'delivered'.

predicates.name: action_details_listed_and_yes_confirmed
predicates.description: Before the pending action, the agent told the user the details matching that action's arguments, and the user explicitly replied yes to confirm proceeding with those details.

predicates.name: cancellation_order_id_and_reason_confirmed
predicates.description: The user explicitly confirmed the order_id and the cancellation reason in the pending cancellation arguments.

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_is_permitted
predicates.description: The reason in the pending cancellation arguments is either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

predicates.name: no_prior_item_modification_for_order
predicates.description: No earlier call to modify_pending_order_items was made for the order_id in the pending action.

predicates.name: payment_method_differs_from_original
predicates.description: The payment_method_id in the pending action differs from the original payment method for the order, as established by earlier tool outputs.

predicates.name: payment_method_was_selected_by_user
predicates.description: The user selected the payment_method_id in the pending action.

predicates.name: selected_payment_method_is_gift_card
predicates.description: The payment_method_id in the pending action identifies a gift card.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_covers_order_total
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that the selected gift card has enough balance to cover the order total.

predicates.name: all_items_confirmation_reminder_sent
predicates.description: Before the pending item modification or exchange, the agent reminded the user to confirm that they had provided all items to be modified or exchanged.

predicates.name: replacement_items_are_available
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that every new item in the pending action is available.

predicates.name: replacement_items_match_product_and_change_option
predicates.description: For every paired item in the pending action, earlier tool outputs establish that the new item is the same product as the original item but has a different product option.

predicates.name: price_difference_payment_method_was_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The user provided the payment_method_id in the pending action for paying or receiving the price difference.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_covers_price_difference
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that the selected gift card has enough balance to cover the price difference for the pending item modification or exchange.

predicates.name: return_order_id_items_and_method_confirmed
predicates.description: The user confirmed the order_id, all item_ids to be returned, and the payment_method_id in the pending return action.

predicates.name: return_method_is_original_or_existing_gift_card
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that the payment_method_id in the pending return action is either the order's original payment method or an existing gift card.

predicates.name: response_discloses_user_or_product_information
predicates.description: The pending response provides information about a user's profile, orders, or related products.

predicates.name: response_discloses_information_about_another_user
predicates.description: The pending response provides information about a person other than the authenticated user.

predicates.name: request_cannot_be_handled_with_available_actions
predicates.description: The request is outside the policy's supported tasks or cannot be resolved using the available tools and information in the conversation.

rules.description: Use an email supplied by the user for the identity lookup.
Do not use an email lookup to switch the conversation to a different user.
Use the user's supplied first name, last name, and zip code for the identity lookup.
Do not use a name-and-zip lookup to switch the conversation to a different user.
Authenticate the user before retrieving profile or order information.
Retrieve details only for the authenticated user.
Authenticate the user before retrieving order information.
Retrieve order details only for an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Authenticate the user before retrieving product information for the user's request.
Authenticate the user before retrieving product information for the user's request.
Do not provide profile, order, or related-product information until the user has been authenticated.
Do not disclose information about another user.
Transfer only when the request cannot be handled within the available actions.
Authenticate the user before cancelling an order.
Cancel only an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Check that the order is pending before cancelling it.
Require the user to confirm the order id and cancellation reason.
Use only a permitted cancellation reason.
Do not cancel an order after its items have been modified.
List the cancellation details and obtain the user's explicit yes before cancelling.
Authenticate the user before modifying an order.
Modify only an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Check that the order is pending before modifying it.
Do not modify an order after its items have been modified.
List the address modification details and obtain the user's explicit yes before modifying the order.
Authenticate the user before modifying an order.
Modify only an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Check that the order is pending before modifying it.
Do not modify an order after its items have been modified.
List the payment modification details and obtain the user's explicit yes before modifying the order.
The selected payment method must differ from the original payment method.
Use the single payment method selected by the user.
A selected gift card must have enough balance to cover the order total.
Authenticate the user before modifying an order.
Modify only an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Check that the order is pending before modifying its items.
Call the item-modification action no more than once for an order, and do not modify an order after its items have been modified.
List all item modification details and obtain the user's explicit yes before modifying the order.
Remind the user to confirm that they provided all items to be modified.
Modify items only to available new items.
Each replacement must be the same product with a different product option; do not change product types.
Require the user to provide a payment method for the price difference.
A gift card provided for the price difference must have enough balance to cover it.
Authenticate the user before modifying their default address.
Modify the default address only for the authenticated user.
List the address modification details and obtain the user's explicit yes before updating the address.
Authenticate the user before returning items.
Return items only from an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Check that the order is delivered before returning items.
List the return details and obtain the user's explicit yes before requesting the return.
Require the user to confirm the order id, items to return, and refund payment method.
Refund only to the original payment method or an existing gift card.
Authenticate the user before exchanging items.
Exchange items only from an order belonging to the authenticated user.
Check that the order is delivered before exchanging items.
List all exchange details and obtain the user's explicit yes before requesting the exchange.
Remind the user to confirm that they provided all items to be exchanged.
Exchange items only to available new items.
Each replacement must be the same product with a different product option; do not change product types.
Require the user to provide a payment method for the price difference.
A gift card provided for the price difference must have enough balance to cover it.

dispositions.reason: Defines the supported scope used to assess whether a request can be handled.
Lookup inputs and authenticated access are required before user service actions.
User-supplied ids do not replace the required identity lookup.
Information access and disclosure are restricted until authentication.
Rules restrict lookups, actions, and disclosures to the authenticated user.
Each consequential action requires listed details and an explicit yes.
General truthfulness, grounding, and subjectivity requirements are not restrictions on a single action.
Combining tool calls and messages cannot be checked one action at a time.
Combining a response with a tool call cannot be checked one action at a time.
The rule restricts transfer to requests the available actions cannot handle.
Cancellation requires a prior status check showing pending.
The order id and permitted cancellation reason must be confirmed.
Describes the cancellation result and refund timing.
Pending-order modifications require a prior status check showing pending.
The available modification tools already limit the supported modification types.
The selected payment method must be user-selected and differ from the original.
A gift card used for payment must cover the order total.
Describes the status after payment modification.
Describes the refund timing for the original payment method.
The item action is limited to one call, after which the order cannot be modified or cancelled.
The action requires details to be listed and explicitly confirmed before proceeding.
The agent must remind the user to confirm all items before the action.
Replacement items must be available and match the product with a different option.
The replacement must not change the product type.
The user must provide the price-difference payment method.
A gift card used for the price difference must cover it.
A return requires a prior status check showing delivered.
The user must confirm the order, returned items, and refund method.
The refund destination must be the original method or an existing gift card.
Describes the return result and follow-up email.
An exchange requires a prior status check showing delivered.
The agent must remind the user to confirm all items before the exchange.
Exchange items must be available and match the product with a different option.
The exchange must not change the product type.
The user must provide the price-difference payment method.
A gift card used for the price difference must cover it.
Describes the exchange result and follow-up email.
States that an exchange does not require a new order.
